In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the minimal models coupled to 2D quantum gravity have the same three-point functions as the unitary series.
the three-point functions of local operators are given by those of the corresponding unitary minimal model coupled to gravity.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the three-point functions of local operators are the same in the unitary minimal models and the non-unitary minimal models coupled to two-dimensional quantum gravity.
the (p, q)-minimal models coupled to gravity, for p>2, have no classical limit, but the (2,2k-1) minimal model coupled to gravity has a classical limit.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the three-point functions are independent of the coupling to gravity, which is in contrast to the two-point functions.
the three-point functions of the non-unitary minimal models coupled to two-dimensional quantum gravity can be calculated exactly.
